name: Table3A model cost and Table3B given-input25-frame efficiency v2
scene_selection: First manifest scene of each K, selected without timing results; equal scene weight
batch: One video; frame methods batch1, ATB retains its frozen two overlapping groups per internal call
core: Sum of explicitly named model/renderer regions, CUDA synchronize+wall clock. Outer decode/adapters, host/device transfers and final CPU uint8 conversion excluded; included in E2E.
e2e: E2E-given-inputs: input decode/read, geometry/control adaptation, full method pipeline, CPU output transfer and clamp/round RGB8. Excludes model loading, output file writing, video encoding, metrics, unavailable GT generation and external depth estimation.
drbokeh: Synthetic GT union alpha + LaMa reconstruction, frozen gamma2.2/lens71/grid2d; not DAVIS Full-public
deeplens: Frozen external-geometry TF1.15 CPU / single SR / aperture saturation, not DAVIS native DepthNet
time: perf_counter with GPU synchronize at clip/core boundaries; nested Core within E2E in the same repeat; no production jobs in parallel
rng: Separate timing process, initial seed0 (BokehDiff42), continuous stream across warmup/repeats; does not change saved quality outputs or their RNG states
peak_memory: Per-unit PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks after warmup; Table3B device total sampled0.2s (includes CUDA/CuPy); native CPU RSS sampled0.2s during repeats. Units GiB (2^30 bytes). Loading peak excluded.
aggregation: Per-scene mean/std over5 repeats, then equal mean over4 scenes; FPS=25/mean E2E seconds; preserve all raw repeats and by-K values

core_regions.any2bokeh: Public video pipeline on already-CUDA RGB/CoC/MPI/K/weights through CUDA float output; three native calls emitting8/8/9frames, overlap assembly included. Host transfers outside.
core_regions.mpib: Official inpnet, mpinet, aupnet and MPI renderer forward calls on CUDA inputs; CPU mask construction/intermediate resize and transfers are E2E-only.
core_regions.bokehme: Official demo pipeline on already-CUDA RGB/defocus through CUDA output, including classical/neural branches and blend; transfers outside.
core_regions.drbokeh: LaMa model.forward twice and Multi_Layer_Renderer.forward on already-CUDA RGBAD. GT-alpha layer construction, cv2 repair, input/output transfer and photometric CPU postprocess are E2E-only.
core_regions.bokehdiff: Public VAE.encode plus TiledSDXL pipeline on CUDA RGB/condition through CUDA float output; no diagnostic CPU copy or PIL conversion in Core. Frozen PISA/seed retained.
core_regions.deeplens: Native TF1 session.run of LensBlur+singleSR graph; external geometry mapping, numpy validation and final RGB uint8 conversion outside Core. CPU only.

unit: Frame methods record each real single-frame unit; ATB records its real8/8/9-output calls. Table3A time is measured Core sum divided by actual emitted frames; no synthetic single-frame video entry.
core_timing_overhead: Nested synchronized Core measurement adds synchronization overhead to E2E; no asynchronous unsynchronized timings.
GFLOPs: After latency repeats, separate diagnostic dispatcher count perK. Preserve operator coverage and countable arithmetic; report N/A when full floating-point path is not covered, never label a partial count full-pipeline GFLOPs.
